system.boundary: Build a physically causal closed-loop forced-air cooling system for a CPU board.
engineering_objects: Build a physically causal closed-loop forced-air cooling system for a CPU board.
The thermal plant must contain distinct finite thermal masses for the CPU, heat-sink base, and fins, joined by physical conductive heat-transfer paths.
A physical fan, inlet and outlet gas path, heat-sink flow channel, and case-flow restriction must remove heat from the fins by forced convection.
physical_paths: The thermal plant must contain distinct finite thermal masses for the CPU, heat-sink base, and fins, joined by physical conductive heat-transfer paths.
Measured CPU temperature must control the real fan power path; the controller form is not prescribed.
Prescribing temperature traces, copying the target, or reporting airflow that is disconnected from the thermal plant is not valid.
Build a physically causal closed-loop forced-air cooling system for a CPU board.
functional_paths: Measured CPU temperature must control the real fan power path;
the controller form is not prescribed.
The controller must increase cooling effort when required, limit CPU temperature, and recover after changes in heat generation.

modes_and_events: F90-XTHERM-07 startup and continuous operation follow the current public task contract.

interfaces.description: Output container declared by the current public task contract.
interfaces.range_or_shape: Log complete-run MATLAB Timeseries named thermal_state, fan_state, and heat_flow. fan_state has 3 channels in this order: physical fan speed (rpm), air mass flow (kg/s), and fan pressure rise (Pa).

interfaces.name: heat_flow
interfaces.description: Output container declared by the current public task contract.
interfaces.range_or_shape: Log complete-run MATLAB Timeseries named thermal_state, fan_state, and heat_flow. heat_flow has 4 channels in this order: physical CPU heat input, CPU-to-base conduction, base-to-fin conduction, and fin-to-air heat transfer, all in W.
